title: Portable Workstations
description: Allows you to spawn in temporary workstations for everyday needs!
body:
**For your players to use the command for each workstation they must first, at some point, had the workstation within their inventory (this does not apply in creative mode). This datapack is a fork of my [Server Utilites](https://modrinth.com/datapack/piano-utilities) datapack. Use it instead if you want more customizable features.**

# Available Workstations
- **Anvil**

- **Cartography Table**

- **Crafting Table**

- **Ender Chest**

- **Enchanting Table**: If a player has, at some point, had at least 15 bookshelves in their inventory, this enchanting table will be level 30

- **Grindstone**

- **Loom**
- **Smithing Table**

- **Stonecutter**


<details>
<summary>**!WARNING FOR ENCHANTING TABLE WORKSTATION!**</summary>

**IF YOU HAVE ANOTHER DATAPACK THAT USES STRUCTURE VOIDS IN ANY WAY, PLEASE DISABLE THIS WORKSTATION AND REMOVE THE TAG LOCATED AT**
datapacks/Server-Utilities-V.X.X.X/data/minecraft/block/enchantment_power_provider
  
</details>

 
# Commands


| Name                 | Command                       | Brief Description                   |
|----------------------|:-----------------------------:|------------------------------------:|
| Anvil                | ```/trigger anvil```          | Spawns a temperary anvil            |
| Cartography Table    | ```/trigger cartograph```     | Spawns a temperary cartography table|
| Crafting Table       | ```/trigger craft```          | Spawns a temperary crafting table   |
| Enchanting Table     | ```/trigger enchant```        | Spawns a temperary enchanting table |  
| Enderchest           | ```/trigger echest```         | Spawns a temperary enderchest       |
| Grindstone           | ```/trigger grind```          | Spawns a temperary grindstone       |
| Loom                 | ```/trigger loom```           | Spawns a temperary loom             |
| Smithing Table       | ```/trigger smith```          | Spawns a temperary smithing table   |
| Stonecutter          | ```/trigger stonecut```       | Spawns a temperary stonecutter      |
